access_token_strategy.description: The access token type generated for this credential request. Defaults to 'OPAQUE'.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: The authentication method to use when issuing the request. Defaults to 'CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC'

name.description: The display name for this client credential

client_id.description: The optional client_id to specify which must be a unique UUID v4 format, if not specified will be generated automatically.

status.description: The status of this OIDC credential which can be disabled or otherwise paused for security reasons.

access_token_lifespan.description: How long the access token is valid for before expiring.

refresh_token_lifespan.description: How long the refresh token is valid for before expiring.

authorized_redirect_urls.description: The HTTP redirect urls that host your web application. This value can't contain wildcards or paths. If you use a port other than 80, you must specify it. For example: https://example.com:8080

scopes.description: The scopes to apply and update for the client.

authorized_origins.description: The HTTP origins that host your web application. This value can't contain wildcards or paths. If you use a port other than 80, you must specify it. For example: https://example.com:8080

userinfo_signed_response_alg.title: UserInfoResponseAlgo
userinfo_signed_response_alg.description: The algorithim to use when returning user info. Switching to RS256 will return a signed JWT token. By default this is the return.
